hint: A fraction in the exponent combines a root and a power. Decide which part of $\tfrac{2}{3}$ means which.

hints.text: A fraction in the exponent combines a root and a power. Decide which part of $\tfrac{2}{3}$ means which.
The denominator $3$ means cube root and the numerator $2$ means square. Take the cube root of $27$ first, then square the result.
The cube root of $27$ is $3$, and $3^2 = 9$, so the value is $9$.

learningObjective: Evaluate a fractional exponent as a root and a power.
explanation: The exponent $\tfrac{m}{n}$ means take the $n$th root and raise the result to the $m$th power. Here that means a cube root and a square.
Take the root first, because it keeps the numbers small: $\sqrt[3]{27} = 3$ since $3 \times 3 \times 3 = 27$.
Then apply the power: $3^2 = 9$, so the value of $27^{2/3}$ is $9$.

alternativeExplanations.title: Rewrite the base as a power
steps: When the base is a perfect power, this route is the cleanest and involves no roots at all.
